name: Final-Project-Amit
description: Bistro Bliss is a user-friendly web app designed for restaurant lovers. It lets you explore the restaurant’s menu, book a table easily, and create an account to keep track of your bookings. Bistro Bliss makes dining out simple and stress-free!

paragraphs: Bistro Bliss is a user-friendly web app designed for restaurant lovers. It lets you explore the restaurant’s menu, book a table easily, and create an account to keep track of your bookings. Bistro Bliss makes dining out simple and stress-free!
features: Create and Manage Accounts: Users can sign up, log in, and update their profile information anytime.
View Menu: Easily browse the restaurant’s menu with all available items and details.
Book a Table: Make table reservations quickly and conveniently through the app.
Manage Bookings: View and track all your bookings directly from your profile.
Menu Management: Admins can add, update, or delete menu items to keep the menu up-to-date.
